get.summary: The latest prediction of one entity (or forecast series) under a saved Predictive model
get.description: PREDICTIVE-SURFACE-1. Gated on canWorkIncidents. kind is segmentation-model, churn-model or forecast-model; for a forecast entityKey is the series key. An unknown kind or model, a model that no longer parses, a row the policy engine denies, or no row for the key are all 404 (existence-hiding). Every row carries its stored explanation, from which it recomputes. The key is returned as the Space masked: token (keyMasked: true) unless the caller holds canRevealLinkEntities.

200.description: Envelope-wrapped: data = {kind, model, entityType, entityKey, keyMasked, asOf, modelVersion, runId, scoredAt} plus, for segmentation-model, {segment, recencyScore, frequencyScore, monetaryScore, recencyDays, frequency, monetary, explanation, history[{asOf, runId, segment}]}; for churn-model, {score (null when insufficient), band, logit, historyDays, explanation, history[{asOf, runId, score, band}]} (history = the last 30 runs, newest first); for forecast-model, points[{status, step, bucket, forecast, lower, upper, backtestMae, backtestSmape, backtestRelMae, historyBuckets, explanation}] for the latest run in step order (one insufficient point with null values when the series is under two seasons).

404.description: No visible prediction for that kind, model and key.
